title: SkillPractise
description: A mod aimed to help player to improve their gaming skills
body:
A Minecraft mod designed to help players train in-game skills more effectively, built on the Fabric modloader.

**Currently supported Minecraft version:** 1.21.4

## Current Features
- Movement keys visualization √
- Bridge building speed detection √
- CPS (Clicks Per Second) counter √
- Night vision game rendering √
- Block interaction hints √

## Planned Features
- Water bucket clutch practice

## Required Dependencies
- Cloth Config (≥17.0.144) [Only 0.0.1-beta-1 needed]
- Mod Menu (≥13.0.3)

## Usage Tips
- Press "G" to open configuration (default keybind)

## Important Notes
- Only compatible with Minecraft 1.21.4
- Cloth Config and Mod Menu are required - missing them will cause crashes
- Early development stage - may contain bugs (please report issues)
- Provides no multiplayer advantages - some features disabled on servers without this mod
- Key visualization remains available even on incompatible servers
- Licensed under GPL v3 (modifications must remain open-source)
- Developers not responsible for any consequences of mod use
